visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a pair of hands using metal tongs to transfer a glistening, brown-cooked duck head from a clean white plate into a large, stainless steel dry pot. The background is a dark, professional setting focusing on the food's texture and oily sheen. (2) Quick cut to a blurred wide shot of a restaurant interior with warm, ambient lighting and customers seated in wooden booths, followed by a close-up of a person's hands tearing into a duck head, revealing the juicy pink meat and sesame seed coating. (3) Sequence of close-ups showing various preparation stages: white, milky broth being poured from a metal kettle into the pot filled with chilies and duck, then a hand adding a large piece of green cabbage to the simmering liquid. (4) Detailed montage of various side dishes being picked up by chopsticks, including small crispy fried fish garnished with greens, sliced abalone mushrooms, and a golden-brown shrimp cake showing its internal pink shrimp meat. (5) A man wearing a black chef's hat, mask, and uniform is seen placing a dish onto a table equipped with an induction cooker. (6) The final scene shows the daytime exterior of a multi-story building with large signage reading '大宅門' against a slightly overcast sky.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-energy, upbeat electronic pop music featuring a strong drum beat and bright synthesizers. A male narrator with a friendly, high-arousal tone introduces the food with clear articulation. A distinct metallic clinking sound occurs as tongs hit a metal pot. (2) The narration continues at a fast pace describing the restaurant's history. A crisp, squelching sound effect mimics the tearing of meat as duck heads are prepared. The BGM maintains a consistent, driving rhythm. (3) A splashing, liquid-pour sound is heard as broth is added to the pot, followed by a faint sizzle. The narrator's pitch rises slightly to express excitement about the ingredients. (4) The audio transitions into a list of side dishes, with the narrator's delivery becoming more rhythmic. Soft percussive thuds and chopstick clicks accompany the visual presentation of various small plates. (5) The music swells slightly for the closing call to action, and the narrator concludes with a warm sign-off. The track ends with a smooth volume fade-out as the building's location is mentioned.
